---

## How Jarvis Stores Memory & Session History

### 📁 Storage Location
All memory is stored **locally on your machine** in:
```
%APPDATA%\Jarvis\
```
Which resolves to something like:
```
C:\Users\Osama\AppData\Roaming\Jarvis\
```

---

### 📄 File Structure (typical)
```
Jarvis/
├── memory.json          ← global memory (preferences, rules)
├── projects/
│   └── login-fullstack/
│       ├── project.json     ← project info, rules, metadata
│       └── history.json     ← conversation history for this project
```

---

### 🔑 Key Points

| Thing | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Multiple sessions** | History is **appended** across sessions — it's cumulative per project |
| **Per-project isolation** | Each project has its own history file, keyed by workspace folder name |
| **Global vs project** | `/rules` edits global memory; `/project rules` edits per-project memory |
| **Clear history** | `/memory clear history` wipes only the history, not project info |
| **Format** | Plain JSON — you can open and read it directly |

---
